narrativeAudit.scope: All 299 authored keys in de/en/es/fr/ru, including invitation, main quests, biographies, four chapters per person, choices, memories, recurring variants and projects.
narrativeAudit.method: Assistant semantic review against live catalog, Definitions/Simulation/Progression/VipStoryService and serialized Cassa authoring. Spanish/French/Russian are rough semantic checks, not native human editorial approval.

economy.coffeeShopSalesNarration: Cannabis buds; cups are story ambience only. Explicit mechanical sale instructions and goal label corrected in five keys.
economy.bakeryConversion: Butter -> Pastry; pastry sales count after production
economy.waterOlivesAndCeramic: Water-network history, terrace gardens and ceramic patterns are narrative/places, not additional production resources.
economy.genericVipVersusPersonalStory: The main everyday quest explicitly asks for a generic VIP task with claimed reward; Ines personal chapter is parallel content. Both namespaces/counters remain separate.

narrativeAudit.freshCounterSemantics: VipStoryService stores city-specific baselines at acceptance and subtracts them on progress. DeliveredGoods counts arriving units; Deliveries counts completed shipments. Existing totals cannot pre-complete these fresh goals.
continuity: Ines shares duty with Rafael and takes a seat saved by Lucia.
Mateo opens his garden with Sofia/Lucia; Nico later returns a seed tin.
Lucia adds her own signature while preserving family memory.
Rafael learns to teach Sofia and plans an evening with Elio.
Sofia keeps her teacher named while allowing other hands and patterns.
Elio asks Nico about quiet hours and listens to Ines/Rafael.
Amara keeps both Ines and Nico accounts without erasing contradiction.
Nico sets boundaries with Ines and becomes a guest at the final gathering.

placeChanges.artMeaning: Existing reusable props represent memories/choices; localized memory and outcome text supplies their specific narrative meaning.

narrativeAudit.recurring: Three goal variants per resident, no expiry field; 300-second pause after completion, existing capped population scaling; residents stay after fourth chapter.

languageNotes.es: The first-four total, aid amounts, shared responsibility and choice alternatives retain the German meaning; the product correction explicitly says flores de cannabis. Café follows the existing localized building name.
languageNotes.fr: Four-city total and local milestones remain distinct; origin notes, testimony and choice consequences remain readable. The corrected sell goal says fleurs de cannabis; café follows the existing localized building name.
languageNotes.ru: Four-city invitation and local resident counts retain the intended distinction; соцветия конопли now names the actual sell resource. Ines/Nico responsibility and boundaries remain intact; proper surnames remain unchanged as catalog names.

narrativeAudit.visualAcceptance: This semantic audit does not substitute for Game View screenshots, touch/audio/device evidence or user art approval.

before.de: Lucia hält einen Platz frei, aber Ines zählt erneut ihre Schlüssel. Baue das Café aus und verkaufe neue Tassen. Rafael übernimmt die Notizen für einen Abend; Ines setzt sich endlich dazu.
before.en: Lucia saves a seat, but Ines counts her keys again. Upgrade the café and sell fresh cups. Rafael takes the notes for an evening; Ines finally joins the table.
before.es: Lucia guarda un sitio, pero Ines vuelve a contar sus llaves. Mejora el café y vende nuevas tazas. Rafael cuida las notas una tarde; Ines por fin se sienta.

before.de: Lucia stellt einen Stuhl an den leeren Markt. Baue das Café aus und verkaufe neue Tassen. Ines setzt sich kurz; Lucia fragt nach Geschmack, nicht nach einem Urteil.
before.en: Lucia puts a chair by the empty market. Upgrade the café and sell new cups. Ines sits briefly; Lucia asks about flavour rather than a verdict.
